title: Skill Typed I/O Contract (NOOA-1, WP-1 core)
description: Machine-readable, deterministic input/output contract for a Brain skill. Complements (does not replace) SKILL.md prose. Authored as JSON (not YAML) because the F:\eduHarness harness is dependency-free (no js-yaml, no ajv) and parses contracts with Node's native JSON.parse. `requires`/`optional` bind the skill to host execution primitives declared in a runtime's `host_capabilities` (harness/schemas/host-capability-profile.schema.json, WP-6); check-host-capabilities.mjs resolves them and yields CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when a required primitive is not `available` on the target runtime.

skill_id.description: Canonical skill id; matches brain/skills/<id> and skill-registry canonical_id.

source_of_truth.description: Relative path to the SKILL.md this contract is derived from.

requires.description: Host execution primitives the skill cannot run without. Each must be `available` on the target runtime's host_capabilities, else CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.

optional.description: Primitives the skill can use if present but does not require; a missing optional primitive never blocks.

inputs.description: Map of input name to its typed definition.

condition.description: Human-readable condition under which a non-required artifact is produced.
